pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit highly irregular, jagged perimeters with sharp pixel gradients. Patch geometry transitions from large, sub-polygonal shapes on the upper neck to significantly smaller, more fragmented shapes on the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological lattice. Junctions consist primarily of tri-point and quadri-point nodes. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but increases in pixel width toward the ventral transition zone.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper cervical ridge displays a dense, low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour consisting of short, upright hairs against the sky background.
